content: Hello! My name is Yoonwoo Jeong. I'm a math undergrad at Korea University. I am currently getting used to using English, and the same goes for Lean programming. I started doing this to overcome laziness and to boast to future generations that I contributed to human civilization. I am not sure what I should contribute, but I am vaguely interested in PDE.
PDEs can definitely use some love in Lean (though there is more and more work ongoing), so you picked a good target
@Luigi Massacci Thank you for the warm welcome. If you don't mind, I would be interested to know—even just in general terms—what kind of projects are involved.
just searching for "PDE" in this Zulip ought to get you far
For distribution theory, there is also a dedicated project, and if you want to work on this I'm more than happy to collaborate.
